summary: Completed frontend testing of Permissions Tab in Settings page. All 10 features tested and working correctly.

minor.issue: WebSocket connection fails with 'closed before established' error - not blocking functionality
500 errors in console logs during page load - not blocking permissions functionality

critical_code_review_comments: PermissionsTab.jsx is well-structured with 13 permissions defined in PERMISSIONS_CONFIG
Role templates (Administrator, Financial Manager, Accountant, HR Manager, Viewer Only) are properly configured
Select All/Deselect All functionality correctly implemented - Deselect All keeps Dashboard as minimum required permission
Search functionality filters employees by name, email, or role
Permission changes are tracked with 'Unsaved' badge and Save/Reset buttons appear when changes are made
CompanySettings.jsx correctly includes Permissions tab for users with management roles (canManageEmployees check)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Permissions Tab in Settings page fully tested.
